summary: Backend smoke test of routes/orders/ package refactor (8 sub-modules replacing the 1377-line orders.py monolith). Created /app/backend/tests/test_orders_refactor.py covering all 8 feature buckets requested: auth, order CRUD, step routes, CAD files, IGI certificates, customs sub-document + multi-file, Digital DNA PDF, and admin recycle-bin. 19/19 tests passed in 11.73s. All routes preserve their pre-refactor URL, method, payload, auth gate and response shape. Resend email paths (CAD, IGI, customs) return 200 with provider_id when sending to delivered@resend.dev. The Digital DNA endpoint returns application/pdf with a valid %PDF magic header. The pre-existing /steps/{n}/forward decorator bug was intentionally NOT tested (preserved as zero-behaviour-change per the request).
action_items: Optional follow-up (pre-existing bug, not a regression): /orders/{id}/steps/{n}/forward in routes/orders/steps.py is missing its @router.post(...) decorator and 404s. The refactor preserved this intentionally. Add the decorator and write a test when ready.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/orders/__init__.py cleanly re-exports a single `router` symbol so server.py needs no changes — refactor is structurally correct.
_shared.py centralises every cross-cutting import + the FileEmailPayload / sanitize_recipients / customs_kind_field helpers; no duplication observed across sub-modules.
All sub-modules correctly project away MongoDB _id via {'_id': 0} in find queries — no ObjectId serialization risk.
Email recipient sanitization (sanitize_recipients) + Resend 50-recipient ceiling enforcement preserved consistently across CAD / IGI / customs.
Manufacturer authorization gates (order.manufacturer_id != user.id) applied uniformly on every multi-tenant route.
seed_data_creation: Each destructive test creates a TEST_REFACTOR_<hex> throwaway order (using seed order's client+manufacturer FKs) and cleans up via soft-delete + purge in a module-scoped fixture teardown. The TestRecycleBin class creates an additional isolated TEST_RECYCLE_<hex> order and fully purges it inside the test. Seed order 165af6bb-89dd-4837-864c-967e4f09d4f6 was only read (never mutated).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Refactor verified. Reuse /app/backend/tests/test_orders_refactor.py as regression suite for any future change to the orders sub-package. The fixtures auto-clean throwaway orders. Resend sandbox only accepts delivered@resend.dev and dean@somnioblinds.com — other recipients yield 502.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no regressions found. Refactor is behaviour-equivalent.
